additionalScopeNotes.qualification: Historical dates are source-specific associations, not independently researched exhaustive chronology.
Industrial deterministic behavior is an idealization, not zero physical uncertainty.
The corridor interpretation is an illustrative semantic inference, not a uniquely proved scene.
Actual footer is 9; population/sample spread conventions and rounded mean are explicit.
Negative plotting baseline is a contour-projection plane, not negative density.
The predicted belief is distinguished by absence of the current measurement despite reused unbarred notation.
Under-reporting slip is the example’s premise, not a universal direction of encoder error.
Missing imports and HTML notebook context are declared. Numerical reconstruction omits the animation stage rather than claiming to reproduce a historical notebook.
Known landmarks are the chosen localization model, not mandatory for all robotics perception.
Literal animate=True is accepted with a deprecation warning in pinned RTB 1.4.4; it is not falsely labeled an execution error.
Accumulating odometry uncertainty is not a monotonicity guarantee for every covariance component.
